description: If \(\varphi(\bar x)\) is preserved under extensions between models of \(T\), any tuple in a model of \(T\) satisfying all existential consequences of \(\varphi\) modulo \(T\) also satisfies \(\varphi\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.existentialConsequences_entail.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {T : L.Theory} {n : ℕ} {φ : L.Formula (Fin n)} (hφ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.ExtensionPreserved T φ)
  (M : T.ModelType) (a : Fin n → ↑M)
  (ha : ∀ ψ ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.existentialConsequences T φ, ψ.Realize a) : φ.Realize a
